Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: priority/order control (page layout)
Preconditions:
User is logged in as Local Administrator
'Ikony zdarzeń' page is loaded
At least 3 events exist on the list, all set as Widoczne = Tak

Step: Verify if each row on the events list has a drag handle icon for reordering (analogous to 'Plany pracy').
Verify if current order of events on the list reflects their configured priority (top = highest priority / first displayed on task).
Hover over the drag handle icon to verify if cursor changes to a 'move' icon.

Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: reorder events via drag-and-drop
Preconditions:
User is logged in as Local Administrator
'Ikony zdarzeń' page is loaded
At least 3 events exist on the list, all set as Widoczne = Tak

Step: Note current order of events on the list (e.g. Event A, Event B, Event C).
Drag Event C and drop it to the first position on the list.
Expected result: Event C moves to the first position.

Step: Verify if the list order updates to: Event C, Event A, Event B.
Refresh the page and verify if the new order persists.

Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: drag-and-drop reorder reflected on calendar
Preconditions:
User is logged in as Local Administrator
'Ikony zdarzeń' page is loaded
At least 2 events exist on the list, both Widoczne = Tak
Task exists on calendar (BOK or Warsztat) where both events occur

Step: Note current icon order on the task in calendar view.
Go to 'Ikony zdarzeń' page and drag the lower-priority event above the other one.
Expected result: Order has been changed on the list.

Step: Go back to calendar and manually refresh it.
Verify if icon order on the task now reflects the new priority (matches updated list order).

Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: drag-and-drop reorder within same resource type only
Preconditions:
User is logged in as Local Administrator
'Ikony zdarzeń' page is loaded
At least 2 events exist configured for different 'Rodzaj zasobu' (e.g. one for Doradca serwisowy, one for Mechanik)

Step: Verify if drag-and-drop reordering is scoped/grouped per 'Rodzaj zasobu' or applies globally across all resource types.
Expected result: It displays correctly (behavior matches intended scope).
